issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Estimate $\norm{u_{\rm F}}{L^2(T)}$ using the left-endpoint value $u_{\rm F}(t_T)$ where $q_T(t_T) = 1$ is uniformly bounded away from 0, and bound the jump recursion at node $t_k$ directly via $|f_{T_k}(t_k)| \le \kappa_0 |f_{T_{k-1}}(t_{k-1})| + |l_{T_{k-1}}(t_k)|$ without passing through point evaluations at $t_{T+1}$.
issues.overall_effect: The inf-sup stability proofs for subspaces of large time steps (Lemma 3.9) and arbitrary regions (Lemma 3.8) become mathematically incomplete as written, undermining the inf-sup stability of the hybrid time stepping scheme in Theorem 3.4 and the rate optimality in Theorem 3.1.
issues.title: Invalid norm equivalence for invisible ansatz functions via right-endpoint evaluation
issues.why_classification: A contained technical revision using the left-endpoint values avoids the vanishing point evaluation at $|T|\lambda = 3$ and restores the uniform estimates without requiring a new global proof architecture or altering any theorem statement or rate.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must formulate a well-defined error metric on the ambient space $\XX_h$ (or a projection-based error such as $\norm{\mathsf{P}_R^{\rm (rb)} u_h - u_{R,\TT_\ell}^{\rm (rb)}}{\XX_R^{\rm (rb)}}$) and establish stability bounds relating the reduced dual norm to the full space dual norm without loss of the advertised exponential convergence rates.
issues.overall_effect: The main error guarantees for the reduced basis model order reduction method (Theorems 4.1, 4.2, and 4.7) fail as stated because the error measure on the left-hand side is mathematically undefined for the true solution $u_h$.
issues.title: Error bounds evaluated in the norm of a reduced subspace to which the solution does not belong
issues.why_classification: The error bound of the central model order reduction theorems is ill-defined on the actual target solution $u_h$, and extending the inf-sup stability control of the time derivative back to the ambient space $\XX_h$ requires essentially new analysis and proof architecture.
